title: Paradoxical Pro-angiogenic Effect of Low-Dose Ellipticine Identified by In Silico Drug Repurposing.
authors: Oh, Jisu; Lee, Hyeon Hae; Jeong, Yunhui; Yoon, Siyeong; An, Hyun-Ju; Baek, Minjung; Kim, Do Kyung; Lee, Soonchul
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子对接进行药物重定位，发现低剂量 ellipticine 促血管生成，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Inadequate vessel maintenance or growth causes ischemia in diseases such as myocardial infarction, stroke, and neurodegenerative disorders. Therefore, developing an effective strategy to salvage ischemic tissues using a novel compound is urgent. Drug repurposing has become a widely used method that can make drug discovery more efficient and less expensive. Additionally, computational virtual screening tools make drug discovery faster and more accurate. This study found a novel drug candidate for pro-angiogenesis by in silico virtual screening. Using Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) microarray datasets related to angiogenesis studies, differentially expressed genes were identified and characteristic direction signatures extracted from GEO2EnrichR were used as input data on L1000CDS(2) to screen pro-angiogenic molecules. After a thorough review of the candidates, a list of compounds structurally similar to TWS-119 was generated using ChemMine Tools and its clustering toolbox. ChemMine Tools and ChemminR structural similarity search tools for small-molecule analysis and clustering were used for second screening. A molecular docking simulation was conducted using AutoDock v.4 to evaluate the physicochemical effect of secondary-screened chemicals. A cell viability or toxicity test was performed to determine the proper dose of the final candidate, ellipticine. As a result, we found ellipticine, which has pro-angiogenic effects, using virtual computational methods. The noncytotoxic concentration of ellipticine was 156.25 nM. The phosphorylation of glycogen synthase kinase-3beta was decreased, whereas the beta-catenin expression was increased in human endothelial cells treated with ellipticine. We concluded that ellipticine at sublethal dosage could be successfully repositioned as a pro-angiogenic substance by in silico virtual screening.
abstract_zh: 血管维护或生长不足会导致心肌梗死、中风和神经退行性疾病等疾病中的缺血。因此，开发一种利用新型化合物挽救缺血组织的有效策略迫在眉睫。药物再利用已成为一种广泛使用的方法，可使药物发现更高效且成本更低。此外，计算虚拟筛选工具使药物发现更快、更准确。本研究通过计算机虚拟筛选发现了一种新的促血管生成药物候选物。利用与血管生成研究相关的基因表达综合数据库（GEO）微阵列数据集，鉴定了差异表达基因，并从GEO2EnrichR提取特征方向签名，作为L1000CDS(2)的输入数据以筛选促血管生成分子。经过对候选物的全面审查，使用ChemMine Tools及其聚类工具箱生成了与TWS-119结构相似的化合物列表。使用ChemMine Tools和ChemminR结构相似性搜索工具进行小分子分析和聚类，用于第二轮筛选。使用AutoDock v.4进行分子对接模拟，以评估第二轮筛选化学物质的理化效应。进行了细胞活力或毒性测试，以确定最终候选物ellipticine的适当剂量。结果，我们通过虚拟计算方法发现了具有促血管生成效应的ellipticine。ellipticine的非细胞毒性浓度为156.25 nM。在用ellipticine处理的人内皮细胞中，糖原合酶激酶-3β的磷酸化降低，而β-连环蛋白表达增加。我们得出结论，亚致死剂量的ellipticine可通过计算机虚拟筛选成功重新定位为促血管生成物质。
